phases.name: Phase 1
phases.focus: Establish safe, moderate-intensity movement with basic strength and mobility

phases.name: Phase 2
phases.focus: Progress to greater circuit variety and controlled resistance under HR limits

phases.name: Phase 3
phases.focus: Enhance general conditioning with progressive loading within safety thresholds

non_negotiables: keep heart rate below 70% age-predicted max (about 115 bpm)

stage2.text:
PLAN "12-week cardiac rehab progressive general fitness"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary:
    name "General fitness for post-MI patient, moderate-intensity, HR<=115 bpm, no max lifts, no valsalva"
PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY conditioning training 30m:
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          treadmill_walk 2x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chair_stretch 5m
      WEEK 1:
        DAY strength training 40m:
          warmup:
            mobility_circuit 5m
          main straight_sets:
            leg_press 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
            leg_extension 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
            seated_row 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
            chest_press 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          cooldown:
            chest_stretch 5m
      WEEK 2:
        DAY conditioning training 30m:
          warmup:
            walking 5m
          main straight_sets:
            bike_cycle 2x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          cooldown:
            calf_stretch 5m
      WEEK 2:
        DAY strength training 40m:
          warmup:
            scapular_retraction 5m
          main straight_sets:
            leg_curl 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
            leg_depression 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
            lat_pulldown 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
            overhead_press 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          cooldown:
            shoulder_stretch 5m
      WEEK 3:
        DAY conditioning training 30m:
          warmup:
            march_in_place 5m
          main straight_sets:
            rowing_machine 2x10 rpe 4 rest 60 seconds
          cooldown:
            hip_flexor_stretch 5m
      WEEK 3:
        DAY strength training 40m:

            bench_press 2x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds

          cooldown:
            chest_stretch 5m
      WEEK 4:

          cooldown:

      WEEK 4:
